text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali formally launched on Tuesday the programme "Tunisia, regional cultural capital" for the year 1997 sponsored by UNESCO.
- Consumer prices stable during the first days of the fasting month of Ramadan. Only fish prices were up because of bad weather.
- Full list of chartered accountants in Tunisia.
- A handbook on financial mathematics and legislation applied to Tunisia's market was published recently.
